local_source.reason: The local released plugin package contains no C++ source files for the animation instance.

facts: It runs on every animation thread-safe update after the engine update call.
It clears RotateInPlaceState.bUpdatedThisFrame before graph update work.
It refreshes layering, pose, view, feet, and transitions before graph On Update functions consume their state.
Speed equals LocomotionState.Speed divided by LocomotionState.ScaleWorldSpace.
StrideBlendAmount is sampled from Settings.Crouching.StrideBlendAmountCurve at Speed.
PlayRate clamps Speed divided by AnimatedCrouchSpeed times StrideBlendAmount to [UE_KINDA_SMALL_NUMBER, 2.0].
HipsDirectionLockAmount is the HipsDirectionLock curve clamped to [-1, 1].
Velocity yaw is calculated in view space before refreshing movement direction and rotation yaw offsets.
The function returns when RotateInPlaceState.bUpdatedThisFrame is already true or settings are invalid.
The first active update marks RotateInPlaceState.bUpdatedThisFrame true, preventing repeated rotation refresh in the same frame.
